description:
Outcome: FIFO waiting list and vacancy assignment; source: brief.md First version 2 and Rules.
Scope: Own atomic initial-finalization transition of all active unallocated applications to FIFO; append later applicants while window open; coordinator records withdrawal/release and assigns next active waiting household.
Excludes: online payments and tool lending; plot map excluded from first version and retained only in T-018.
Acceptance: Server timestamp plus sequence orders queue; returning priority never reorders it; no silent skipping active head; active holdings unique, ended holdings remain historical; released/withdrawn households cannot reapply same season.
Behaviour: Clear empty queue and stale-request recovery; idempotent retries; history retained.
Verification: Tests for late application to vacancy, tie order, release/reassignment/history, withdrawal, concurrent assignment and initial-finalization race.
Prerequisites: T-008.
Assumptions: Approved setup assumptions: one household account; coordinator configures local timezone/application window; default occupancy March 1-October 31; returning means immediately prior season; initial final allocation after February 1 cutoff, advisory preferences and application order within groups; FIFO waiting list; no same-season reapplication after withdrawal/release; active holdings unique, history preserved; own active-plot reporting with coordinator-only report access; daily digest defaults to 08:00 local and skips empty days. No existing implementation. T-003 reviews provisional domain rules.
title: FIFO waiting list and vacancy assignment
